cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your train, taste the soup from this clean spoon. We don't judge seasoning from the cooking ladle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One pinch, then stir and taste again. You can't approve an adjustment you haven't tasted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have eight minutes to get to the station.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then a teaspoonful, not a mouthful. Blow on it first; haste is how we got your first burnt-tongue verdict.

reason: Make every delay a precise tasting correction; train urgency changes portion and cooling procedure rather than introducing a new unrelated food.
